misprints.note: Printed 'ἐξαι-ρεσις' across a line break with no accent visible on either part. Kept without the accent.

uncertain.note: The line ends 'δια' with only a faint dot where the hyphen should be. I took it as a broken hyphen and wrote the word whole.
The breathing on the alpha is small. It looks rough, so I wrote ἁ, not the OCR's ἀ.
